tasks.title: Rebuild Canvas as a 2D flow viewer with trace replay and simulation
acceptance: The Three.js workspace and the three dependency are gone; the canvas is a 2D React Flow graph with dagre layout, pan, zoom, fit, minimap, collapsible folder groups and a details panel
A pasted GitHub link becomes an architecture view and one flow per entry point (console scripts, commands, MCP tools, main, any function) through the local bridge; every view exports to Mermaid
A simplicio.trace/v1 JSONL run, or the JSON printed by simplicio-loop turbo in provider or host mode, replays step by step with play, pause, step, speed and a timeline
A request typed by the user is simulated into a synthetic trace with an explanation for every step and an unknown mark for every undecidable branch; nothing is executed
The viewer stays local-first: the local bridge is the only network call and production builds carry a Content-Security-Policy
verify: headless browser sweep with no console warnings or errors
evidence: 48 test files and 389 tests pass; line coverage 97.8% (scope in vite.config.mjs)

System test tests/system-flow-viewer.test.ts (a real simplicio-mapper scan when the binary is on PATH), regression test tests/regression-fixed-defects.test.ts, benchmark tests/render-benchmark.test.ts
